name: NF candidate remediation-scope decision
purpose: Decide only whether each selected NF candidate alters the architecture remediation boundary; do not add issues

decisions.title: Process-local idempotency store (per-instance Map)
decisions.boundary_delta: AUD-002 fix scope expands from 'key binding + middleware order' to include 'explicit declaration of the single-instance correctness assumption + migration trigger condition when scaling out'.
decisions.why_not_does_not_alter: The correctness premise changes from in-process semantics to deployment-topology semantics; without the declaration, horizontal scaling silently breaks idempotency and AUD-002 acceptance (no cross-subject hits) cannot detect it.
evidence: backend/middleware/idempotencyMiddleware.js:1-2 (self-note: memory store only suitable for single instance; Redis recommended for production)
deploy/README.md:20-21 (systemd single process; PostgreSQL single instance)
deploy/README.md:106-112 (existing precedent: 'known limitations before switching to multi-instance' section for the security-alert scanner)
Same process-level state family: authMiddleware.js:220-221 (recheck fail counter), :483 (guestVisibleTypesCache), :205 (auth state cache injection point)
constraints_for_remediation: AUD-002 acceptance adds: document how idempotency behaves under multi-instance deployment (extend the existing README known-limitations list; no new chapter required)
Recommended cross-issue documentation deliverable: one consolidated 'single-instance assumptions' checklist listing all process-level state and the triggers requiring change
If horizontal scaling is planned within ~6 months, escalate to a storage-backend decision (Redis/DB) and align with AUD-001/021/022 client-queue changes in the same wave

decisions.title: Disabled school re-enabled after schema evolution breaks with P2022
decisions.boundary_delta: RC-04 target architecture must add a 'school enable/disable schema-alignment path'; the scenario must be part of AUD-008/009 acceptance, otherwise the AUD-009 downgrade (self-heal to check-and-alert) creates a new gap.
decisions.why_not_does_not_alter: This is not an implementation detail but a missing branch of the evolution-discipline target architecture (schema state machine across the school lifecycle). Leaving it outside 008/009 would make the AUD-009 fix appear to introduce a regression.
evidence: backend/routes/schoolRoutes.js:404-422 (status PATCH performs no provision/align call)
Reusable capability already exists: tenantProvisioner.js:244-272 alignTenantSchema (not invoked on enable)
constraints_for_remediation: AUD-008/009 acceptance must explicitly include: 'disable school -> schema.prisma evolves (new column) -> re-enable -> business endpoints usable'; absence of this check means the AUD-009 fix is incomplete

The 'check' phase must also cover disabled schools (otherwise the branch is unobservable); alignment must be an explicit action on the enable path (or an optional deep check without destructive flags)
Not a separate issue; if Astra requires a traceable entry, split as P2 but keep the fix inside the RC-04 batch
decisions.separate_finding_note: Only candidate in this batch that could optionally be split as a P2 entry (see constraints)

decisions.title: Plaintext full-dump SQL written to shared /tmp during restore
decisions.boundary_delta: None at the architecture level (task ledger, staging namespace exclusivity, ownership checks, mutual exclusion/write barrier remain the design). Adds one implementation-specification item: private directory + streaming (or encrypted temp) + crash-residue cleanup.
decisions.why_does_not_alter: The restore engine is being refactored for AUD-004/005 anyway; the temp-file location/lifetime is naturally included in that refactor and introduces no extra architectural decision, schema change, or deployment dependency.
evidence: backend/lib/restoreService.js:127-133 (os.tmpdir() + mode 0600 + finally unlink; residue possible on crash)
Existing private-directory precedent: backupService.js:330-331 (backup dir chmod 0700)
constraints_for_remediation: RC-03 implementation spec: plaintext must not land in shared /tmp; prefer streaming into psql; if disk is required, use the backup private directory and integrate residue cleanup with the restore task ledger
Optional acceptance: after an injected restore interruption, no plaintext residue readable by other local users

decisions.title: Second-batch injection sinks (detail modals) + 8 divergent escapeHtml implementations
decisions.boundary_delta: AUD-003 upgrades from 'escape the known sinks' to 'establish a unified safe-rendering abstraction + enumerate and close ALL sinks'; the 8 divergent escapeHtml implementations must be consolidated first and become a prerequisite.
decisions.why_not_does_not_alter: This is a solution-level change (point-fix vs building an abstraction); NF-C-02 is the structural cause of NF-C-01 recurrence (8 implementations mean each new module can create another sink).
evidence: Independent sinks proven: Pathogen.js:1181 and GenericTest.js:350-352 (detail/logs) vs GenericTest.js:1332/1345-1347 (list); probe confirmed img[onerror] and div[onmouseover]

8 escapeHtml implementations (read-only recount this phase): utils/schoolCustomization/shared.js, modules/backupManager.js, modules/AuditLog.js, modules/adminSchools/ui.js, modules/adminSchools/sidebar.js, modules/adminSchools/views/diskView.js, modules/adminSchools/views/backupView.js, modules/adminSchools/views/openApiView.js
Partial mitigation to preserve: ExportService.js:688 already escapes table cells via _escapeHtml
constraints_for_remediation: Produce a sink census (innerHTML / insertAdjacentHTML / document.write / attribute context title="${...}" / export preview / print) before implementation; close items against the census, not against 'list fixed'
Consolidate the 8 helpers into one shared implementation as a prerequisite; do not patch modules in parallel (divergence and inconsistent escaping semantics would grow)
Not a separate issue: C-01/C-02 are scope and prerequisite of AUD-003
